title: Nvidia rents CoreWeave cloud capacity, ~$320M paid by 2024

sources.quote: As of December 31, 2024, NVIDIA has paid us an aggregate of approximately $320 million pursuant to the Master Services Agreement and related order forms.

explain: Under a master services agreement signed in April 2023, Nvidia rents computing capacity from CoreWeave; by the end of 2024 it had paid about $320 million. Nvidia is CoreWeave's chip supplier, shareholder and customer at the same time.
